summary: Tested Rest, Fatigue, Food and Water System for LOTR 5e Travel. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend CONFIG. VIAJES 'Comida' tab verified with FoodWaterEditor modal. Rest modal with 3 options (Corto, Largo, Santuario) code verified. Day-by-day mode UI setup flow tested.
critical_code_review_comments: REST_TYPES constant correctly defines 3 rest options (lines 1234-1258): short, long, sanctuary
Long rest requires CON roll with base CD 10, with provisions modifiers
Sanctuary rest removes all fatigue but requires being near a refuge
Rest and Forage buttons have correct data-testid attributes (rest-btn, forage-btn)
